answer: A practical defence is Gazetted space insurance underwriter licence with space insurers attestation. It rests on a licence insurers renew after risk audits, which gives every honest agent a raven that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. What the farm fears is not one hard check but a check that cannot be shared: a licence insurers renew after risk audits is per-account by construction, and the ridge is that the tenth clone costs as much as the first. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the vine is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
